summary: Robo.ai Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a business update and interim report schedule. The company completed the disposal of its legacy operations, eliminating most historical liabilities, and acquired Neurovia AI (AI data processing rights) and Quantum Core Capital (AI holding platform), and established Alif Holding (technology infrastructure). These transactions aim to turn shareholders' equity positive. No financial terms, prices, or advisors were disclosed. The interim results for H1 2026 are not comparable to prior periods. What to watch: revenue impact from new businesses and equity position in upcoming financial statements.
